a.text: The Rock Crystal egg was created in 1896 for Empress Alexandra Feodorovna.

b.text: Nicholas II presented the egg to Alexandra Fedorovna.

a.text: Nicholas and Alexandra had just been married two years prior, in 1894.

b.text: Nicholas and Alexandra were engaged to be married at Veste Coburg during the wedding of Alexandra's brother Ernie in 1894.
